BALA KANDA 
0 Rama, the mighty son of Vishala was named Hemachandra, 
and his son was the renowned Sucbandra. 0 Rama, the son 
of Sucbandra was Dhumrashwa and his son was Srinjaya. 
The glorious Sabadeva was the son of Srinjaya and the son 
of Sabadeva was the highly vinuous Krisbashwa. 
The son of Krisbashwa was Somadatta and his son was 
Kakusrba. The most illustrious and invincible of warriors 
King Pramati the son of Kakustba, is the present ruler of 
Visbala. 
By the grace of King Ikswaku all the rulers of Visbala are 
long lived, virtuous and mighty. 
0 Rama, let us pass the night here, and to-morrow we will 
wait upon King Janaka. 
When the powerful King Pramati heard of Shri Vishwamitra's 
arrival in his kingdom, he went with his spiritual preceptor 
and relatives to welcome him. 
With joined palms, they offered him due worship and enquired 
as to his welfare. The king said : " 0 Muni, to-day I am 
indeed fortunate rbat thou bast been gracious enough to visit 
my kingdom. None is more blessed rban I."
